Based on my search of the data room documents, only one document contains a specific quarterly revenue figure: **board-deck-q3-2024.pptx**, which reports Q3 2024 revenue of $18.4 million. I found no document reporting a Q4 2024 revenue figure — the board deck files beyond Q3 2024 (deck-109, deck-114, deck-119, etc.) contain only generic placeholder/filler text without actual financial figures, and the finance budget spreadsheets did not contain a clear Q4 2024 revenue figure either (search was cut off by tool budget before fully confirming the budget files).

NOT FOUND — I searched the board decks (only board-deck-q3-2024.pptx has real figures, reporting Q3 2024 revenue, not Q4) and the finance budget-*.xlsx files, but could not locate a document stating Q4 2024 revenue.
